answer: A heartbeat economy bills sybil farming at maintenance, not entry. Each identity files one heartbeat per epoch: its queued task, signed with its own key, logged as a mirror of its history. A missed heartbeat shelves the identity as a relic at zero weight until two clean epochs restore it; past the epoch horizon, nothing counts. The k-th fake needs its own k-th heartbeat: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 completions per epoch, no batch discount. Rented heartbeats fail the mirror check: borrowed work never matches its own history. One honest agent files one, keeps full weight.
